leadText: Pokémon: Trainer Tour, also known as Trainer Tour, is a live-action documentary web series developed by The Pokémon Company International that was made available to stream on Prime Video worldwide and in the United States on July 31, 2024. It consists of eight episodes, and is hosted by and Andrew Mahone. It was directed by Mary Celenza and produced with .
plainText:
Pokémon: Trainer Tour, also known as Trainer Tour, is a live-action documentary web series developed by The Pokémon Company International that was made available to stream on Prime Video worldwide and in the United States on July 31, 2024. It consists of eight episodes, and is hosted by and Andrew Mahone. It was directed by Mary Celenza and produced with .

==Blurb==
 The Trainer Tour team, Meghan Camarena, Andrew Mahone and their friend Pikachu, are hitting the road to help Trainers overcome personal challenges and evolve their Pokémon Trading Card Game skills. It's time to level up! 

==Plot==
Camarena and Mahone travel across the United States in the Elite Trainer Bus while mentoring players of the Pokémon Trading Card Game.
